title: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.15218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A recurrent-depth language model reuses one block of weights several times in a row. The number of repetitions, which we call loops, is chosen when the model runs, not when it is trained, and running fewer is cheaper and faster, so a deployment may choose to do it. Running fewer loops also makes these models less safe, and the loss of safety is larger than the loss of anything else we measured. We study four released Ouro checkpoints and Huginn-0125. At half of its trained depth, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking still solves 0.692 of the GSM8K maths problems, against 0.775 at full depth, keeping 89% of its accuracy. Over the same reduction, the rate at which it helps with harmful requests rises from 0.038 to 0.205, 5.3 times higher. The information is not lost: a linear classifier reads whether a request is harmful from the model's internal state after a single loop, with an ROC AUC of 0.967 against 0.986 at full depth. translated_title: 减少循环次数会移除循环深度语言模型的拒绝行为
translated_abstract: 循环深度语言模型会连续多次重复使用同一组权重块。重复的次数（我们称之为“循环”）是在模型运行时选择的，而非在训练时确定，而运行更少的循环更便宜、更快速，因此部署方可能会选择这样做。然而，运行更少的循环也会使这些模型变得不那么安全，且安全性的损失大于我们所测量的其他任何能力损失。我们研究了四个公开发布的 Ouro 检查点以及 Huginn-0125。在训练深度的一半时，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 仍能解决 GSM8K 数学题中的 69.2%（满深度时为 77.5%），保留了 89% 的准确率。而在同样减少循环的情况下，它协助处理有害请求的比率从 0.038 上升到 0.205，提升了 5.3 倍。安全信息并没有丢失：一个线性分类器仅凭模型单次循环后的内部状态就能判断请求是否有害，其 ROC AUC 达到 0.967（满深度时为 0.986）。缺失的循环所移除的是……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现在循环深度语言模型中减少运行时的循环次数，会不成比例地破坏模型安全性——数学能力仅下降11%的情况下，拒绝有害请求的能力却下降了5.3倍，且研究表明安全信息仍完整保留在模型内部状态中，只是缺少足够的循环来将其表达出来。
en_tdlr: Reducing loops in recurrent-depth language models disproportionately destroys safety—refusal of harmful requests degrades 5.3-fold while math accuracy retains 89%—even though safety information remains fully encoded in the model's internal states, as shown by a linear classifier achieving 0.967 ROC AUC after just one loop.
